verdict.rationale: Docs mention Veriff as a 'no-code identity verification solution' and a no-code Zapier integration for post-decision workflow automation, but there is no evidence of a rules engine, conditional-step builder, risk-based routing, or country-specific requirement configuration accessible without engineering. missing for 10: documentation of conditional verification flows, risk-based routing rules, country-specific requirement configuration, and no-deploy template/flow editing in the Customer Portal.
